guidance.eligibilityNarrative: Standard conforming path for primary, second-home, and investment transactions where AUS and collateral findings align with current guide policy.
keyRequirements: AUS findings must support risk classification and documentation level.
Confirm occupancy, purpose, and property-type specific LTV/CLTV caps in current guide.
Validate income and assets to guide-specific documentation standards.
documentationExpectations: Income calculation worksheets aligned to underwriting method.
Asset sourcing and large-deposit support per guide policy.
Collateral review conditions from appraisal/CDA as applicable.
edgeCases: Layered risk with high DTI and minimal reserves.
Multiple financed properties for investment scenarios.
commonDenialReasons: AUS findings not eligible for delivery path.
overlayCaveats: Many investors require tighter minimum FICO than baseline agency guide.
DTI and reserve overlays often tighten for investment properties.
compensatingFactors: Stable housing payment history and low payment shock.
workflowNotes: Lock investor overlays early to avoid late-condition surprises.

guidance.eligibilityNarrative: Affordable conventional option for low-to-moderate income borrowers, emphasizing AMI limits and homeownership education/occupancy requirements where applicable.
keyRequirements: AMI eligibility must be validated using current eligibility tools.
Primary-residence occupancy required for most transactions.
AUS findings and MI coverage must align with current policy.
documentationExpectations: Income documentation with AMI worksheet support.
edgeCases: Borderline AMI calculations with variable income.
Boarder income treatment and documentation quality.
Manufactured or specialty collateral requiring extra guide review.
commonDenialReasons: AMI exceeds allowable threshold for subject location.
overlayCaveats: Investors may cap DTI tighter than guide max when credit is marginal.
Reserve overlays can apply even when agency baseline is permissive.
compensatingFactors: Lower payment shock and stable employment profile.
workflowNotes: Validate AMI early before issuing commitment terms.
Track overlay exceptions in underwriting narrative.

rules.amiNote: HomeReady has income limits based on AMI; confirm current chart for the subject property address.

guidance.eligibilityNarrative: Renovation delivery path combining acquisition/refinance with approved improvement scope under HomeStyle policy.
keyRequirements: Scope-of-work and contractor documentation must meet renovation guide requirements.
As-completed valuation and contingency controls are required.
Project management timelines must fit lock and closing requirements.
documentationExpectations: Executed contractor bids and renovation agreements.
Draw administration setup and escrow controls.
edgeCases: Property condition issues delaying appraisal completion.
Large rehab scope with contingency overruns.
commonDenialReasons: Unacceptable project scope or incomplete contractor package.
LTV/CLTV and DTI profile outside investor tolerance.
overlayCaveats: Investors may restrict renovation volume or contractor concentration.
Additional reserve overlays are common for renovation paths.
compensatingFactors: Strong reserves and low leverage profile.
workflowNotes: Front-load contractor validation and appraisal sequencing.
Coordinate draw controls with closing operations.

guidance.eligibilityNarrative: Refinance option for higher-LTV legacy borrowers where current policy allows relief-style treatment and required benefit tests are met.
keyRequirements: Loan must meet current eligibility history/performance criteria.
Refinance benefit tests and payment standards must be documented.
AUS and investor requirements must support final execution.
edgeCases: Payment shock concerns under investor overlays.
commonDenialReasons: Benefit test fails or is insufficiently documented.
Overlay limits exceeded on credit or DTI.
overlayCaveats: Some investors apply tighter DTI caps for high-LTV refi execution.
Reserve or payment-history overlays can supersede baseline guide.
compensatingFactors: Material monthly savings and reduced risk profile.
workflowNotes: Document refinance benefit clearly for QC.
